response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced software engineer but has no meaningful match to the role's core requirements: minimal recent C++ experience (a brief stint in 2014-2015 using C/C++ for an IDE), no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a short unrelated fintech stint at RIDE Capital using Node/TypeScript/GraphQL.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many stacks
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up in new domains and technologies
concerns: C++ experience is minimal, outdated (2014-2015), and not on Windows platform
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle expertise; SQL exposure appears limited to MySQL/MongoDB

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/relevant C++ Windows experience
No fixed income/capital markets domain background
